arms_geometry.shared_origin: The repository provenance audit matches this geometry to PlateForge CREST_PATH, whose source comment describes a vector conversion of a generated master.
arms_geometry.evidence_limit: Shared geometry establishes reuse, not historical accuracy. The supplied fragment already carries data-accuracy="approximate". Its drawing is not verified against these three document specimens.

typography.identification: Serif capitals, condensed government caption, and blackletter classes only.
typography.evidence_limit: No exact typeface, size, spacing standard, or printer attribution established.

reconstruction.colour: Recolouring is a study control; it is not evidence of a historical colourway.
reconstruction.period_standard_status: No independently verified period graphic standard for the three supplied headers was found.

research_cautions: The screenshot creation timestamps are not dates of the depicted documents.
The 1977 Visual Identity Program manuals concern the coordinated badge identity and do not automatically establish earlier document-heading rules.
The Forgotten Crest (Over the Edge, 9 October 2026) is authored by Ahmad Jalil and describes the same project; it was not used as independent corroboration.
